0022600203.text: The Lakers arrive at 9-2, first in the Pacific and first in the West, with a five-game winning streak and an 8-2 record over their last ten, while the Hawks are 7-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, riding a four-game streak. Los Angeles is without Quentin Grimes (out, finger), and Austin Reaves is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Lakers winning the last meeting 141-116 in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
